model_evidence_limit: Request parameters and statements are not execution receipts. No capacity fallback was reported in this round.

reviewers.role: Independent math, identifiability and counterexample review
reviewers.pre_execution_conclusion: Counterexample valid. Color readout risks 0,0,0,.5; blue readout .1 throughout; selection regret .4. Preserve N per physical unit. Nondecreasing gains commute even with intermediate clipping. Existing single clipping does not invalidate predicted clipped joint under assumptions. Pure-power gamma preserves multiplicative identity; arbitrary fixed monotone response need not. These are two fixed readouts, not trained policies.
reviewers.post_execution_static_review: 静态核对无实质数学错误，无需重跑。风险、2/5 后悔值、交换律、阈值和未知单调响应反例均成立。四个支持状态是精确加权总体风险，16行记录不是16个独立样本。网格仅枚举x∈[0,1]。未知响应反例仅对一个像素/通道的三元观测成立，没有验证同时拟合主反例整幅RGB。纯幂枚举指数为2、3，一般正指数结论属代数推广。351个达到白点与350个严格超阈值已正确区分。实际Sol/max档位无回执。
reviewers.required_correction_applied: Report now explicitly limits unknown-response counterexample to scalar observations, not a verified fit to the whole main RGB construction. No code rerun was needed.

reviewers.final_conclusion_verbatim: 最终先例边界：Unprocessing与UltraLED已覆盖增益乘法、线性RAW缩放及饱和处理，Afifi–Brown已覆盖WB误差的识别后果，RAW-Adapter已覆盖亮度/通道增益增强及组合变化下的收益差异，但四篇已读原文未见‘单因素均未饱和、联合新增截断合并判别线索，导致单因素验证漏判排序’的等价检验；Rawgment与Neural Auto-Exposure原文均403，仍不能排除直接覆盖，且不换路径获取，因此当前可保留两个固定读出的机制候选，不能称AA/RA/TA实证或已证新颖，Sol/max请求保持而实际档位未核验。

decision: Retain a specific controlled-mechanism candidate, not a validated real-CV or novelty claim. A new selection algorithm is not a prerequisite for investigating the mechanism.
